Sonia (product): Heads-up — rolling out the new On‑Prem Delegated Ops & Data Access Policy in v3.4.1 today. This introduces delegated operator accounts (fine-grained RBAC for customer operators), a configurable emergency-access window, and automated local audit bundles. Customers can opt into delegated mode; existing installs will remain unchanged until migration is applied.

Sonia (product): Key compliance notes: delegated operators are fully auditable (local bundle + signed attestations). For SOC/ISO customers we now require periodic operator key rotation and attestations enabled by default for Wave 2 pilots.

ReleaseBot: Deploy: tag=v3.4.1-onprem-delegatedops -> canary in us-west-2 at 3632109905 :rocket:

Asha (eng): question — what's the opt-in UX for current customers? will this be a config toggle or an automated migration?

Sonia (product): Opt-in is a config toggle + optional migration assistant. We provide a safe dry-run: `redwoodctl access migrate --dry-run` and a guided flow if they choose to convert operator accounts. No forced changes.

Miguel (docs): I'll start a short KB and a migration checklist. Can you drop the CLI examples I should include?

Sonia (product): Put these in the KB please:
```
# enable delegated ops (dry-run)
redwoodctl access migrate --mode delegated --dry-run

# apply with 72h emergency window and enable audit bundles
redwoodctl policies set --delegated-ops on --emergency-window 72h --audit-bundles auto
```

Kendra (sales): sales ask — what are the top 3 customer-facing points I should use on calls?

Sonia (product): Quick bullets for calls: 1) Delegated Ops lets customers grant limited operator rights to their infra teams without exposing keys. 2) Everything is auditable locally + signed attestations for compliance. 3) Migration is opt-in + dry-run supported, low-friction.

Tony (eng-oncall): Ops question — if delegated operator auth fails, is there an automatic fallback so customer apps don't see failures?

Sonia (product): Yes — we built an automatic fallback to host-managed emergency operator when delegated auth rejects, configurable with a cooldown. We log fallback events into the audit bundle and surface alerts to the Console.

Asha (eng): I'll create the migration runbook and run it against a staging customer tomorrow. tagging @Tony to update oncall runbooks if fallback needs manual ops.

Tony (eng-oncall): ack. I'll update runbooks and add a dashboard tile for fallback rate.

Miguel (docs): Drafted KB outline and CLI snippets. I'll ping for review when ready.

Kendra (sales): thanks — can you add a one-paragraph compliance blurb for SSO customers? need it for customer slides.

Sonia (product): Sure, short blurb: "Delegated Ops supports SSO-integrated operator accounts, role mapping, and audited session recordings. Combined with local signed attestations, this meets common SOC2/ISO evidence requirements for operator activity."

Sonia (product): Action items: Sonia -> publish announcement + compliance blurb; Asha -> migration runbook + staging run; Miguel -> KB + CLI examples; Tony -> oncall + dashboard tile.

ReleaseBot: Canary deploy completed at 3632110200, monitoring windows open for 4h.

Asha (eng): :thumbsup: will post progress in #eng-oncall and tag this thread.

Kendra (sales): :raised_hands: thanks team, will start outreach to pilot customers this afternoon.

Sonia (product): Thanks all — please thumbs-up this thread when your item is done so we can mark GA for the next wave.
